mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which may lead to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 1%) for three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which encourages risk-taking and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 month-over-month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a robust economy, which boosts corporate output and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within a month.
